root_cause_analysis: Policy states 'MRI should be considered for age < 35 to reduce radiation dose'. Extraction flags rule as NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW because wording is advisory ('should be considered') rather than an absolute contraindication to CT.
remediation_proposal: Clarify in clinical guideline policy notes whether advisory recommendation mandates denial of CT Abdomen/Pelvis or functions as an informational notification to ordering physician.

root_cause_analysis: DEP-010 requires health plan specific stress test tiering crosswalk. In the absence of payer contract configuration, engine correctly halts with MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
remediation_proposal: Implement payer tiering schedule table in Phase 3E intake connector to evaluate whether patient's specific benefit plan mandates treadmill ECG first.

root_cause_analysis: DEP-008 documents that state Medicaid controlled substance rules impose a hard cap of 4 epidural steroid injections per 12 months, overriding clinical necessity guidelines.
remediation_proposal: Maintain DEP-008 route guard in policy router to prevent automated commercial criteria from approving excess injections on Medicaid LOB.

root_cause_analysis: DEP-011 limits adult proton coverage under commercial HMO plans to skull base and pediatric tumors. Prostate cancer request requires payer custom exception review.
remediation_proposal: Maintain PLAN_SPECIFIC_ACCESS_REQUIRED routing when procedure 77520 is requested under commercial HMO lines of business.

root_cause_analysis: DEP-013 documents health plan annual visit caps (e.g. 30 visits). Member has used 32 visits. Clinical progress cannot override contractual benefit exhaustion without rider.
remediation_proposal: Configure intake service to decrement annual visit accumulator prior to clinical necessity evaluation.

root_cause_analysis: DEP-014 documents employer group custom benefit exemption lists allowing direct attended in-lab polysomnography without prior HSAT.
remediation_proposal: Incorporate employer group exemption schedule query into case intake context to resolve exemption deterministically.

root_cause_analysis: DEP-015 documents commercial payer non-covered genetic panel exclusion schedules. Broad panels are non-covered regardless of family history without medical director pre-authorization.
remediation_proposal: Add payer panel exclusion code crosswalk table in intake connector.

root_cause_analysis: DEP-002 documents CMS State Operations Manual discharge planning requirements: DME delivery to inpatient hospital is non-covered unless within 48h of discharge for home readiness.
remediation_proposal: Enforce discharge delivery timing validation during case intake.
